text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a compacte launch plan for the tiny-starterkit OSS refapp. Goal: blog + one webinar + short tutorial series + a benchmark blurb. Target publish next Wed. Who can take which piece?

sam: I can draft the blog outline. thinking: problem statement, quickstart, perf callouts, link to repo, CTAs for signup. will mock CTAs for inbound routing.

jess: Webinar lead here — can do 30m demo + 15m Q&A. Need speakers and runbook. prefer Tues or Wed afternoon. also can record and turn into two 5–7m clips for socials.

oliver: I can pull the benchmark numbers. quick ask: which config we want highlighted? small-quantized on A100 or the dedicated profile? p95 and cost per 1k tokens are the key metrics.

bryan: I'll map inbound flows into HubSpot. need final UTM params and form copy. also recommend two nurture tracks: "starter" and "enterprise".

maria: @sam outline + hero screenshot. @oliver bench numbers (p50/p95, cost). @jess webinar outline + speaker list. @bryan inbound form + UTMs. i can do social snippets and launch post copy.

sam: Outline draft: 1) why tiny-starterkit, 2) quick 5-min install, 3) perf snapshot, 4) integrations, 5) next steps + community repo link. putting in doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE (work-in-progress).

jess: For webinar: 1) intro + why, 2) live demo (setup -> query -> optimize), 3) benchmark walk-through, 4) Q&A. speakers: me, @maria for product bits, @oliver for numbers. prefer Wed 2pm PT.

oliver: Current numbers (internal test): p50 85ms, p95 210ms on dedicated-small, approx $0.18 / 1k tokens with batching & cache. I'll run the quick spot-check on the reference prompts and paste logs.

bryan: UTMs draft: utm_source=oss_refapp&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=tiny_starterkit_launch. form fields: name, email, company, use_case. send webhook to /marketing/oss-leads.

maria: couple of micro-tasks: - sam: include a short benchmark callout box with the numbers and a link to full benchmark notebook. - jess: record webinar dry-run Fri. - bryan: ensure the webhook maps to two nurture lists.

sam: ack. adding code snippet for quickstart in blog.

sam: ```bash
# install
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/tiny-starterkit.git
cd tiny-starterkit
poetry install
./run_demo.sh
```

jess: can we also have one workshop-style tutorial for DevRel to run at meetups? 20–30m hands-on with the refapp. i'll draft slides.

oliver: dropping the perf log (trimmed):
```
2025-06-10 14:02:12 INFO p50=85ms p95=210ms tokens=512 cost_est=$0.18/1k
```

bryan: routing note: inbound leads from webinar should be tagged `webinar_tiny_starterkit` and get immediate email with repo + quickstart. nurture track 1: tips + best practices (7-day cadence). track 2 (enterprise): contact from AE.

maria: timeline: Fri EOD — blog draft + bench numbers; Mon — webinar run-through; Tue — final assets + forms; Wed publish + webinar. is that realistic?

sam: realistic. I'll have draft by Fri morning.

jess: run-through Mon 10am PT works for me.

oliver: bench rerun scheduled Fri 9am PT, will paste final numbers then.

bryan: i'll create the HubSpot form tonight and add webhook mapping, will share playbook for routing.

devrel-bot: Checklist created: [tiny-starterkit-launch] - blog draft, benchmark notebook, webinar runbook, hubspot form, social assets. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/launch-checklists/tiny-starterkit

maria: perfect — thanks all. i'll assemble a launch PR with all links once we have final numbers. ping here when you update the doc so i can compile socials. :rocket:

jess: sending calendar invites now.

sam: updated the doc with the benchmark box and quickstart snippet. pinged @oliver for final numbers.

oliver: posted final numbers and notebook link in doc.

bryan: form live and webhook confirmed. test lead posted to /marketing/oss-leads — pls verify.

maria: verified test lead, looks good. moving to final publish checklist. :thumbsup:
